free_tier.stated: 'You'll get 25 compute hours per month for free' with Xcode 15.0 or later and Apple Developer Program membership, which is an annual membership; extra hours cost US$49.99, US$99.99, US$399.99 or US$3,999.99 a month and unused hours do not roll over

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: not published: the product page, get-started page and enrollment page price compute hours and the membership but state no egress allowance, price or network policy

interface_detail: Workflows are configured in Xcode; the App Store Connect web dashboard shows build and test results, and workflows can be edited and builds launched from the web.

limits.value: 25 compute hours a month included, then 100 hours for $49.99, 250 for $99.99, 1,000 for $399.99 and 10,000 for $3,999.99
the hours are gated on an Apple Developer Program membership; there is no free account path to them
a workflow is configured in Xcode and runs against an app target, so it is a build of self-hosted code

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. Exceeds capacity threshold.

identity_cost.detail: An Apple Account with two-factor authentication plus legal name, email, phone and address for an individual, or legal binding authority, legal entity name, D-U-N-S Number, work email and website for an organization; the USD 99 annual membership is purchased after verification.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
